title: Tailoring grain boundary resistance in Li-ion conducting polymer–ceramic hybrid electrolytes based on polyether and Li1.5Al0.5Ge1.5(PO4)3
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41530-41536
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07453C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Naamo Suzuki, Koji Hiraoka, Koji Ohara, Kenta Fujii, Shiro Seki
Polyether/Li1+xAlxGe2−x(PO4)3 hybrid electrolytes were investigated to assess the effect of inorganic crystallinity, and exhibited low-temperature ionic conductivity and reduced grain boundary resistance.
